Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

Kaiming He
Xiangyu Zhang
Shaoqing Ren
Jian Sun

Microsoft Research

{kahe,˜v-xiangz,˜v-shren,˜jiansun}@microsoft.com

Abstract

Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers—8× deeper than VGG nets [41] but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers.

1Introduction

Deep convolutional neural networks [22, 21] have led to a series of breakthroughs for image classification [21, 50, 40]. Deep networks naturally integrate low/mid/high-level features [50] and classifiers in an end-to-end multi-layer fashion, and the “levels” of features can be enriched by the number of stacked layers (depth). Recent evidence [41, 44] reveals that network depth is of crucial importance, and the leading results [41, 44, 13, 16] on the challenging ImageNet dataset [36] all exploit “very deep” [41] models, with a depth of sixteen [41] to thirty [16]. Many other nontrivial visual recognition tasks [8, 12, 7, 32, 27] have also greatly benefited from very deep models.

1

Driven by the significance of depth, a question arises: Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers? An obstacle to answering this question was the notorious problem of vanishing/exploding gradients1 [1, 9], which hamper convergence from the beginning. This problem, however, has been largely addressed by normalized initialization [23, 9, 37, 13] and intermediate normalization layers [16], which enable networks with tens of layers to start converging for stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with backpropagation [22].

先说它是什么。反向传播求梯度靠链式法则，一层一层往回乘。L 层网络里，最靠前那层的梯度是 L 个雅可比矩阵连乘的结果。设每一层平均把梯度缩放 s 倍：

s = 0.9 L = 50 0.9⁵⁰ ≈ 0.005 梯度消失 s = 1.0 L = 50 1 刚好 s = 1.1 L = 50 1.1⁵⁰ ≈ 117 梯度爆炸

指数是关键：s 只要偏离 1 一点点，乘 50 次就会差好几个数量级。消失了前面几层收不到信号、根本不更新；爆炸了参数一步跳飞、损失变成 NaN。

为什么当年特别容易消失。那时激活函数普遍用 sigmoid，它的导数最大只有 0.25（在 x = 0 处），两端还趋近于 0。每过一层至少乘掉 4 倍，十层就是 4¹⁰ ≈ 100 万倍。

论文说它「已经基本被解决」，靠的是这两样（原文：largely addressed by normalized initialization 和 intermediate normalization layers）：

初始化按扇入扇出定权重方差，让 s 一开始就接近 1。Xavier 取 2/(nin+nout)，He 取 2/nin（配 ReLU）
Batch Normalization每层都把分布拉回去，不只管起点，管整个训练过程。初始化只保证第一步，权重一更新就漂了

这句话在论文里的作用是「排除法的第一步」。作者要说的是：梯度问题已经不是拦路虎了，几十层能正常收敛 —— 那退化就得另找原因。第 4.1 节还专门补了实测：带 Batch Normalization 的普通网络，前向方差非零、反向梯度范数健康，两头都没消失，可 34 层的训练误差就是比 18 层高。

所以这一篇解决的不是梯度消失。这两个问题常被混为一谈，但论文把它们明确分开了：梯度消失是「信号传不过去」，退化是「信号传得过去，可优化器就是找不到更好的解」。

1

When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly. Unexpectedly, such degradation is not caused by overfitting2, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error, as reported in [11, 42] and thoroughly verified by our experiments. Fig. 1 shows a typical example.

看训练误差。过拟合的定义是模型在训练集上学得太好、在测试集上反而变差，所以过拟合一定长成「训练误差更低、测试误差更高」。

而论文观察到的是：56 层网络的训练误差从头到尾都比 20 层高（Fig. 1 左）。ImageNet 上同样如此，34 层普通网络的训练误差全程高于 18 层（Fig. 4 左）。两条曲线同向，不是过拟合的形状。

更硬的一条论证在下一段。论文给了个构造：拿训练好的浅网络，把多出来的层全部设成恒等映射，其余照抄。这个构造出来的深网络，训练误差必然不高于浅网络。所以「更深的网络训练误差更高」不可能是表达能力的问题 —— the solution space of the 18-layer plain network is a subspace of that of the 34-layer one。

那只剩一种解释：优化器找不到那个解。这是全篇的问题定义 —— 退化是个优化问题，不是容量问题也不是泛化问题。

1

The degradation (of training accuracy) indicates that not all systems are similarly easy to optimize. Let us consider a shallower architecture and its deeper counterpart that adds more layers onto it. There exists a solution by construction to the deeper model3: the added layers are identity mapping, and the other layers are copied from the learned shallower model. The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart. But experiments show that our current solvers on hand are unable to find solutions that are comparably good or better than the constructed solution (or unable to do so in feasible time).

因为它把退化从「可能是模型不够强」彻底排除掉了，剩下的只能是优化。

构造本身很简单：

浅网络： L 层，已经训练好 深网络： 前 L 层照抄浅网络的权重 后面多出来的层，每层都设成恒等映射 f(x) = x

这个深网络在每个输入上的输出都和浅网络逐位相同，所以训练误差也相同。换句话说：深网络的解空间里一定存在一个不差于浅网络的解。

但实验里优化器找不到它。论文的原话是 our current solvers on hand are unable to find solutions that are comparably good or better than the constructed solution。

然后残差结构做的事就是：把这个构造解挪到起点上。要让残差块变成恒等，只要 ℱ ≡ 0；而权重初始化本来就在 0 附近。原来要靠一堆非线性层凑出恒等映射，现在只要「不动」。

论文第 3.1 节把这层意思说得更直白：The degradation problem suggests that the solvers might have difficulties in approximating identity mappings by multiple nonlinear layers。

1

In this paper, we address the degradation problem by introducing a deep residual learning framework. Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping. Formally, denoting the desired underlying mapping as ℋ⁡(𝐱), we let the stacked nonlinear layers fit another mapping of ℱ⁡(𝐱):=ℋ⁡(𝐱)−𝐱. The original mapping is recast into ℱ⁡(𝐱)+𝐱. We hypothesize that it is easier to optimize the residual mapping4 than to optimize the original, unreferenced mapping. To the extreme, if an identity mapping were optimal, it would be easier to push the residual to zero than to fit an identity mapping by a stack of nonlinear layers.

这一句是全篇的机关。改的不是网络能表示什么，是让优化器从哪儿起步。

设这几层最终该实现的映射是 ℋ(x)。原来的做法是让这几层直接把 ℋ(x) 学出来；改完之后让它们学 ℱ(x) := ℋ(x) − x，然后在输出上把 x 加回去：

原来 这几层的输出 = ℋ(x) 现在 这几层的输出 = ℱ(x)，块的输出 = ℱ(x) + x

两种写法的表达能力完全相同 —— 任何 ℋ 都能写成 ℱ + x，反过来也是。论文自己也说这是 equivalent 的。所以这不是一个「能不能表示」的改动。

差别只在起点。权重初始化在 0 附近，所以一个刚初始化的块，ℱ(x) ≈ 0，整个块的输出 ≈ x —— 它天然从「什么都不做」开始。原来的写法里，同样的初始化给出的是 ℋ(x) ≈ 0，也就是「把输入抹成零」，离恒等映射差得远。

顺带一提 := 这个符号：它读作「定义为」，不是在断言两边相等，而是在说「以下把左边这个名字派给右边这个东西」。

The formulation of ℱ⁡(𝐱)+𝐱 can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections” (Fig. 2). Shortcut connections [2, 34, 49] are those skipping one or more layers. In our case, the shortcut connections simply perform identity mapping, and their outputs are added to the outputs of the stacked layers (Fig. 2). Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity. The entire network can still be trained end-to-end by SGD with backpropagation, and can be easily implemented using common libraries (e.g., Caffe [19]) without modifying the solvers.

We present comprehensive experiments on ImageNet [36] to show the degradation problem and evaluate our method. We show that: 1) Our extremely deep residual nets are easy to optimize, but the counterpart “plain” nets (that simply stack layers) exhibit higher training error when the depth increases; 2) Our deep residual nets can easily enjoy accuracy gains from greatly increased depth, producing results substantially better than previous networks.

Similar phenomena are also shown on the CIFAR-10 set [20], suggesting that the optimization difficulties and the effects of our method are not just akin to a particular dataset. We present successfully trained models on this dataset with over 100 layers, and explore models with over 1000 layers.

On the ImageNet classification dataset [36], we obtain excellent results by extremely deep residual nets. Our 152-layer residual net is the deepest network ever presented on ImageNet, while still having lower complexity than VGG nets [41]. Our ensemble has 3.57% top-5 error on the ImageNet test set, and won the 1st place in the ILSVRC 2015 classification competition. The extremely deep representations also have excellent generalization performance on other recognition tasks, and lead us to further win the 1st places on: ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation in ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions. This strong evidence shows that the residual learning principle is generic, and we expect that it is applicable in other vision and non-vision problems.

2Related Work

Residual Representations. In image recognition, VLAD [18] is a representation that encodes by the residual vectors with respect to a dictionary, and Fisher Vector [30] can be formulated as a probabilistic version [18] of VLAD. Both of them are powerful shallow representations for image retrieval and classification [4, 48]. For vector quantization, encoding residual vectors [17] is shown to be more effective than encoding original vectors.

In low-level vision and computer graphics, for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), the widely used Multigrid method [3] reformulates the system as subproblems at multiple scales, where each subproblem is responsible for the residual solution between a coarser and a finer scale. An alternative to Multigrid is hierarchical basis preconditioning [45, 46], which relies on variables that represent residual vectors between two scales. It has been shown [3, 45, 46] that these solvers converge much faster than standard solvers that are unaware of the residual nature of the solutions. These methods suggest that a good reformulation or preconditioning can simplify the optimization.

Shortcut Connections. Practices and theories that lead to shortcut connections [2, 34, 49] have been studied for a long time. An early practice of training multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) is to add a linear layer connected from the network input to the output [34, 49]. In [44, 24], a few intermediate layers are directly connected to auxiliary classifiers for addressing vanishing/exploding gradients. The papers of [39, 38, 31, 47] propose methods for centering layer responses, gradients, and propagated errors, implemented by shortcut connections. In [44], an “inception” layer is composed of a shortcut branch and a few deeper branches.

1

Concurrent with our work, “highway networks” [42, 43] present shortcut connections with gating functions [15]. These gates are data-dependent and have parameters5, in contrast to our identity shortcuts that are parameter-free. When a gated shortcut is “closed” (approaching zero), the layers in highway networks represent non-residual functions. On the contrary, our formulation always learns residual functions; our identity shortcuts are never closed, and all information is always passed through, with additional residual functions to be learned. In addition, highway networks have not demonstrated accuracy gains with extremely increased depth (e.g., over 100 layers).

差在那条旁路关不关得掉。两篇几乎同期，都在层与层之间搭旁路，但一个带开关、一个不带。

恒等旁路（本文） y = ℱ(x) + x Highway y = ℱ(x)·T(x) + x·(1 − T(x))

T(x) 是一个由 x 算出来、带自己权重的开关，取值在 0 到 1 之间。三种极端情况：

T → 1旁路关死，退回普通堆叠 —— 退化问题原样回来
T → 0主路关死，这一段等于没有
0 < T < 1两条路按比例混，学的不再是残差

恒等旁路没有这个自由度 —— x 那一项永远原封不动加进来，没有任何东西能把它掐断。论文这句的落点是 in contrast to our identity shortcuts that are parameter-free：门是数据相关且带参数的，恒等旁路不带参数。

实测（Table 6，CIFAR-10）：

Highway 19 层2.3 M 参数7.54%
Highway 32 层1.25 M 参数8.80% —— 层数加倍反而更差
ResNet 110 层1.7 M 参数6.43%

论文对 Highway 那一路的评价是它们 have not demonstrated accuracy gains with extremely increased depth —— 旁路带开关的话，深度这条路走不远。

3Deep Residual Learning

3.1Residual Learning

Let us consider ℋ⁡(𝐱) as an underlying mapping to be fit by a few stacked layers (not necessarily the entire net), with 𝐱 denoting the inputs to the first of these layers. If one hypothesizes that multiple nonlinear layers can asymptotically approximate complicated functions2, then it is equivalent to hypothesize that they can asymptotically approximate the residual functions, i.e., ℋ⁡(𝐱)−𝐱 (assuming that the input and output are of the same dimensions). So rather than expect stacked layers to approximate ℋ⁡(𝐱), we explicitly let these layers approximate a residual function ℱ⁡(𝐱):=ℋ⁡(𝐱)−𝐱. The original function thus becomes ℱ⁡(𝐱)+𝐱. Although both forms should be able to asymptotically approximate the desired functions (as hypothesized), the ease of learning might be different.

This reformulation is motivated by the counterintuitive phenomena about the degradation problem (Fig. 1, left). As we discussed in the introduction, if the added layers can be constructed as identity mappings, a deeper model should have training error no greater than its shallower counterpart. The degradation problem suggests that the solvers might have difficulties in approximating identity mappings by multiple nonlinear layers. With the residual learning reformulation, if identity mappings are optimal, the solvers may simply drive the weights of the multiple nonlinear layers toward zero to approach identity mappings.

1

In real cases, it is unlikely that identity mappings are optimal, but our reformulation may help to precondition the problem. If the optimal function is closer to an identity mapping than to a zero mapping, it should be easier for the solver to find the perturbations with reference to an identity mapping6, than to learn the function as a new one. We show by experiments (Fig. 7) that the learned residual functions in general have small responses, suggesting that identity mappings provide reasonable preconditioning.

指 ℱ(x) 本身 —— 相对恒等映射的那一点点偏移量。

把块的输出写成 ℱ(x) + x，x 是主体，ℱ(x) 是叠在上面的修正。如果这一段最优解就是「什么都不做」，那 ℱ 只要压到 0；如果最优解离恒等不远，ℱ 也只要输出一个小量。论文赌的就是后一种情况在深网络里更常见。

这不是空口断言，第 4.2 节有实测。Fig. 7 量了每一层输出（BN 之后、ReLU 之前）的标准差，也就是 ℱ 的幅度：

ResNet 各层普遍落在 0.8–1.0
同深度的普通网络普遍在 1.0–2.2
越深的 ResNet单层幅度更小

论文的原话是 the residual functions might be generally closer to zero than the non-residual functions。层数越多，摊到每一层要改的就越少。

脚注

2 This hypothesis, however, is still an open question. See [28].

3.2Identity Mapping by Shortcuts

We adopt residual learning to every few stacked layers. A building block is shown in Fig. 2. Formally, in this paper we consider a building block defined as:

𝐲=ℱ⁡(𝐱,{Wi})+𝐱. (1)

Here 𝐱 and 𝐲 are the input and output vectors of the layers considered. The function ℱ⁡(𝐱,{Wi}) represents the residual mapping to be learned. For the example in Fig. 2 that has two layers, ℱ=W2​σ​(W1​𝐱) in which σ denotes ReLU [29] and the biases are omitted for simplifying notations. The operation ℱ+𝐱 is performed by a shortcut connection and element-wise addition. We adopt the second nonlinearity after the addition (i.e., σ⁡(𝐲), see Fig. 2).

1

The shortcut connections in Eqn.(1) introduce neither extra parameter nor computation complexity7. This is not only attractive in practice but also important in our comparisons between plain and residual networks. We can fairly compare plain/residual networks that simultaneously have the same number of parameters, depth, width, and computational cost (except for the negligible element-wise addition).

省参数是次要的，真正的理由是让对比成为受控实验。这一段自己写出来了：

We can fairly compare plain/residual networks that simultaneously have the same number of parameters, depth, width, and computational cost。

参数量、深度、宽度、计算量四项全部相同，唯一的变量就是那条线。要是捷径带参数，「34 层 ResNet 比 34 层普通网络好」就可以被解释成「因为参数多」，整篇的论证就塌了。

这一点在 Table 3 上是可核对的：plain-34 和 ResNet-34 选项 A 的参数完全相同（21,623,848，按 Table 1 结构逐层算出），错误率却从 28.54 掉到 25.03。

不过「free」不是全免。论文自己也留了个括号：except for the negligible element-wise addition。两处代价：

那次加法一个 56×56×64 的块要加 200,704 次，占同块卷积乘加的 0.087%
显存x 必须留到加法那一刻，这部分内存不是免费的

前者确实可以忽略，后者在今天训练大模型时是要认真算的一笔账。

1

The dimensions of 𝐱 and ℱ must be equal in Eqn.(1). If this is not the case (e.g., when changing the input/output channels), we can perform a linear projection8 Ws by the shortcut connections to match the dimensions:

它们不是三种东西。捷径是那条绕过卷积层、把输入直接送到加号的线；「恒等」和「投影」说的是这条线上面放什么；「无参数」是恒等捷径的一个性质。

式 (1) y = ℱ(x, {Wᵢ}) + x ← 恒等捷径 式 (2) y = ℱ(x, {Wᵢ}) + Wₛx ← 投影捷径

两个式子只差最后一项。

identity（恒等）就是数学上的恒等函数 f(x) = x。捷径上不做任何变换，x 原封不动加到输出上。没有权重、没有矩阵、没有乘法。

projection（投影）里的 Wₛ 是一个要学的线性映射，卷积网络里用 1×1 卷积实现。它唯一的作用是把 x 的形状掰成跟 ℱ(x) 一样，参数量是 Cin × Cout。

parameter-free（无参数）形容的就是前者：恒等那条路上没有 Wₛ，捷径带来的参数是 0。

那什么时候非用投影不可？形状对不上的时候。以 ResNet-34 从 conv2_x 走进 conv3_x 为例：

x（捷径送来的）56×56×64
ℱ(x)（主路算出的）28×28×128

通道翻倍、空间减半，逐元素加法要求两边一一对应，根本加不起来。这种地方在 ResNet-34 里只有 3 处，其余 13 条捷径全是恒等的。

𝐲=ℱ⁡(𝐱,{Wi})+Ws​𝐱. (2)

We can also use a square matrix Ws in Eqn.(1). But we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical, and thus Ws is only used when matching dimensions.

The form of the residual function ℱ is flexible. Experiments in this paper involve a function ℱ that has two or three layers (Fig. 5), while more layers are possible. But if ℱ has only a single layer, Eqn.(1) is similar to a linear layer: 𝐲=W1​𝐱+𝐱, for which we have not observed advantages.

We also note that although the above notations are about fully-connected layers for simplicity, they are applicable to convolutional layers. The function ℱ⁡(𝐱,{Wi}) can represent multiple convolutional layers. The element-wise addition is performed on two feature maps, channel by channel.

3.3Network Architectures

We have tested various plain/residual nets, and have observed consistent phenomena. To provide instances for discussion, we describe two models for ImageNet as follows.

2

Plain Network. Our plain baselines (Fig. 3, middle) are mainly inspired by the philosophy of VGG nets [41] (Fig. 3, left). The convolutional layers mostly have 3×3 filters and follow two simple design rules: (i) for the same output feature map size, the layers have the same number of filters9; and (ii) if the feature map size is halved, the number of filters is doubled so as to preserve the time complexity per layer. We perform downsampling directly by convolutional layers that have a stride of 2. The network ends with a global average pooling layer and a 1000-way fully-connected layer10 with softmax. The total number of weighted layers is 34 in Fig. 3 (middle).

第二条是关键：if the feature map size is halved, the number of filters is doubled so as to preserve the time complexity per layer。

为什么翻倍正好抵消。一层卷积的乘加数是 H·W·k²·C_in·C_out：

空间减半H·W → H·W / 4少了 4 倍
通道翻倍Cin·Cout 变 4 倍多了 4 倍
合起来两者相抵每层开销不变

结果是每个 stage 的计算预算大致相等，不会全堆在浅层。这条规则继承自 VGG。

具体到 ResNet-50 的四个 stage：

conv2_x56×56瓶颈内部 64主干 256
conv3_x28×28128512
conv4_x14×142561024
conv5_x7×75122048

所以主干维度不是一直 256，256 只是第一个 stage。固定不变的是 expansion = 4 这个比例：1×1 降到 C，3×3 在 C 上做，1×1 升回 4C。ResNet-50/101/152 只改每个 stage 堆几个块，通道配置完全一样。

基础块版本（ResNet-18/34）的 expansion = 1，主干维度就是 64 / 128 / 256 / 512。

替掉的是 VGG 那种巨大的全连接头。

全局平均池化把每个通道的整张特征图拍成一个数：7×7×512 → 1×1×512，取的就是那 49 个数的平均。它零参数，而且输出维度只跟通道数有关、跟输入图片尺寸无关。

省下来的量级很惊人。VGG-16 的全连接头：

25088 × 4096 = 102,760,448 4096 × 4096 = 16,777,216 4096 × 1000 = 4,096,000 ─────────────── 123,633,664

这一个头就占了 VGG-16 全部 1.38 亿参数的 90%。而 ResNet-34 全网才 2180 万参数，比 VGG-16 那个头还小。

全连接层没有被删掉，只是缩到一层。最后那个 1000 路全连接是分类器本身 —— 要把 512 维特征映射到 1000 个类别的分数，这一步不可省。它的参数是 512 × 1000 = 512,000，占 ResNet-34 的 2.4%。

顺带澄清一个容易读漏的地方：VGG 那三层全连接之间是有 ReLU 的（还有 Dropout）。写成 FC 4096 → FC 4096 只是省略写法。要是中间真没有非线性，两个线性层会塌缩成一个，堆再多也等于一层。

It is worth noticing that our model has fewer filters and lower complexity than VGG nets [41] (Fig. 3, left). Our 34-layer baseline has 3.6 billion FLOPs (multiply-adds), which is only 18% of VGG-19 (19.6 billion FLOPs).

Residual Network. Based on the above plain network, we insert shortcut connections (Fig. 3, right) which turn the network into its counterpart residual version. The identity shortcuts (Eqn.(1)) can be directly used when the input and output are of the same dimensions (solid line shortcuts in Fig. 3). When the dimensions increase (dotted line shortcuts in Fig. 3), we consider two options: (A) The shortcut still performs identity mapping, with extra zero entries padded for increasing dimensions. This option introduces no extra parameter; (B) The projection shortcut in Eqn.(2) is used to match dimensions (done by 1×1 convolutions). For both options, when the shortcuts go across feature maps of two sizes, they are performed with a stride of 2.

3.4Implementation

1

Our implementation for ImageNet follows the practice in [21, 41]. The image is resized with its shorter side randomly sampled in [256,480] for scale augmentation [41]. A 224×224 crop is randomly sampled from an image or its horizontal flip, with the per-pixel mean subtracted [21]. The standard color augmentation in [21] is used. We adopt batch normalization (BN) [16] right after each convolution and before activation11, following [16]. We initialize the weights as in [13] and train all plain/residual nets from scratch. We use SGD with a mini-batch size of 256. The learning rate starts from 0.1 and is divided by 10 when the error plateaus, and the models are trained for up to 60×104 iterations. We use a weight decay of 0.0001 and a momentum of 0.9. We do not use dropout [14], following the practice in [16].

顺序是「卷积 → BN → ReLU」，跟 BN 原论文一致。放在激活之前，是为了让进入 ReLU 的分布是被归一化过的。

Batch Normalization 归一化的是「同一个通道、跨整个 batch 的所有像素」。设特征图是 (N, C, H, W)：

Batch Normalization固定一个通道 c，对 (N, H, W) 全部求均值方差 —— 一共 C 组统计量
Layer Normalization固定一个样本 n，对 (C, H, W) 全部求 —— 一共 N 组

为什么图像上 BN 好用：每张照片尺寸一样、通道一样，同一个通道在每张照片上都有同样多的真实像素。ImageNet 上 batch 开到 256，一组统计量就有上千万个数，稳得很。

今天的分化：

卷积视觉仍以 Batch Normalization 为主
Transformer一律 Layer Normalization：句子长短不齐、有 padding，同一位置上的有效 token 数不一样，batch 维度上的统计量不可靠
小 batch 场景检测/分割常用 Group Normalization；论文实测 batch 降到 2 时 BN 的误差明显上升，GN 基本不受影响

一个容易踩的坑：Layer Normalization 在两个领域形状不一样。图像上它按整张照片做，切出来是一片；Transformer 里它按 token 逐个做（对每个 (n, t) 的 d 维向量），切出来是一根柱子。同一个名字，两种粒度。

In testing, for comparison studies we adopt the standard 10-crop testing [21]. For best results, we adopt the fully-convolutional form as in [41, 13], and average the scores at multiple scales (images are resized such that the shorter side is in {224,256,384,480,640}).

4Experiments

4.1ImageNet Classification

We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset [36] that consists of 1000 classes. The models are trained on the 1.28 million training images, and evaluated on the 50k validation images. We also obtain a final result on the 100k test images, reported by the test server. We evaluate both top-1 and top-5 error rates.

Plain Networks. We first evaluate 18-layer and 34-layer plain nets. The 34-layer plain net is in Fig. 3 (middle). The 18-layer plain net is of a similar form. See Table 1 for detailed architectures.

The results in Table 2 show that the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net. To reveal the reasons, in Fig. 4 (left) we compare their training/validation errors during the training procedure. We have observed the degradation problem - the 34-layer plain net has higher training error throughout the whole training procedure, even though the solution space of the 18-layer plain network is a subspace of that of the 34-layer one.

1

We argue that this optimization difficulty is unlikely to be caused by vanishing gradients. These plain networks are trained with BN [16], which ensures forward propagated signals to have non-zero variances. We also verify that the backward propagated gradients exhibit healthy norms with BN. So neither forward nor backward signals vanish. In fact, the 34-layer plain net is still able to achieve competitive accuracy (Table 3), suggesting that the solver works to some extent. We conjecture that the deep plain nets may have exponentially low convergence rates12, which impact the reducing of the training error3. The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.

这是排除法走到最后放下的一个猜想，而且下一句作者自己就承认没证出来。

前面排除了什么：

怀疑梯度消失排除。都带 Batch Normalization，前向方差非零，反向梯度范数也实测过，健康
怀疑求解器失效排除。34 层普通网络最终 top-1 还有 28.54%，确实在学
剩下的可能在学，但太慢

convergence rate 指的不是「能不能收敛」，是每走一步优化损失往下掉多少。训练预算固定（最多 60×10⁴ 次迭代），速率低就意味着时间到了还没走到底。

exponentially 是相对深度说的：达到同样损失所需的迭代次数随层数 L 按 cᴸ 增长，而不是线性或平方。18 层加到 34 层是多 16 层，若每层多花 r 倍：

r = 1.1 慢 4.6 倍 r = 1.2 慢 18.5 倍 r = 1.5 慢 657 倍 （多项式级只有 1.9 到 3.6 倍）

「指数」这个词是被脚注 3 那个实验逼出来的：他们把迭代次数加到 3 倍，退化依然在。多项式级的话 3 倍基本能覆盖；指数级的话，3 倍连最温和的 4.6 倍都不够。脚注用了 feasibly 一词，说的就是这个。

后半句 which impact the reducing of the training error 的落点在 training。拖住的是训练误差，不是测试误差 —— 这是优化问题，不是泛化问题。

最后：这至今没有定论。措辞是 conjecture + may 叠用，在这篇通篇笃定的论文里很罕见，紧接着就是 The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future。后来的工作给的是别的解释 —— 破碎梯度、损失曲面、隐式集成，退化问题仍没有公认的理论解释。

Residual Networks. Next we evaluate 18-layer and 34-layer residual nets (ResNets). The baseline architectures are the same as the above plain nets, expect that a shortcut connection is added to each pair of 3×3 filters as in Fig. 3 (right). In the first comparison (Table 2 and Fig. 4 right), we use identity mapping for all shortcuts and zero-padding for increasing dimensions (option A). So they have no extra parameter compared to the plain counterparts.

We have three major observations from Table 2 and Fig. 4. First, the situation is reversed with residual learning – the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%). More importantly, the 34-layer ResNet exhibits considerably lower training error and is generalizable to the validation data. This indicates that the degradation problem is well addressed in this setting and we manage to obtain accuracy gains from increased depth.

Second, compared to its plain counterpart, the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2), resulting from the successfully reduced training error (Fig. 4 right vs. left). This comparison verifies the effectiveness of residual learning on extremely deep systems.

Last, we also note that the 18-layer plain/residual nets are comparably accurate (Table 2), but the 18-layer ResNet converges faster (Fig. 4 right vs. left). When the net is “not overly deep” (18 layers here), the current SGD solver is still able to find good solutions to the plain net. In this case, the ResNet eases the optimization by providing faster convergence at the early stage.

1

Identity vs. Projection Shortcuts. We have shown that parameter-free, identity shortcuts help with training. Next we investigate projection shortcuts (Eqn.(2)). In Table 3 we compare three options: (A) zero-padding shortcuts are used for increasing dimensions, and all shortcuts are parameter-free13 (the same as Table 2 and Fig. 4 right); (B) projection shortcuts are used for increasing dimensions, and other shortcuts are identity; and (C) all shortcuts are projections.

三个方案其实只在两处分别做选择。ResNet-50 有 16 条捷径：4 条所在位置维度会变（每个 stage 的第一块），12 条形状本来就对得上。

A会变的：补零（0 参数）不变的：恒等
B会变的：1×1 投影不变的：恒等
C会变的：1×1 投影不变的：1×1 投影

A 和 B 在右列完全一样，B 和 C 在左列完全一样。所以后文那句「换成投影就翻倍」讲的是 B → C，不是 A → B。

整网的账（ResNet-50，按 Table 1 结构逐层算出）：

A 22,780,456 B 25,557,032 比 A 多 2,776,576 +12.2% 差 4 条 C 40,128,552 比 B 多 14,571,520 +57.0% 差 12 条

实测差距（Table 3，10-crop top-1）：plain-34 是 28.54，A 是 25.03，B 是 24.52，C 是 24.19。关键跳跃是 3.51，发生在「没有捷径 → 有捷径」这一步；换成投影只再赚 0.51 和 0.33。

论文的结论因此是 projection shortcuts are not essential for addressing the degradation problem，后文全程弃用 C。

Table 3 shows that all three options are considerably better than the plain counterpart. B is slightly better than A. We argue that this is because the zero-padded dimensions in A indeed have no residual learning. C is marginally better than B, and we attribute this to the extra parameters introduced by many (thirteen) projection shortcuts. But the small differences among A/B/C indicate that projection shortcuts are not essential for addressing the degradation problem. So we do not use option C in the rest of this paper, to reduce memory/time complexity and model sizes. Identity shortcuts are particularly important for not increasing the complexity of the bottleneck architectures that are introduced below.

2

Deeper Bottleneck Architectures. Next we describe our deeper nets for ImageNet. Because of concerns on the training time that we can afford, we modify the building block as a bottleneck design144. For each residual function ℱ, we use a stack of 3 layers instead of 2 (Fig. 5). The three layers are 1×1, 3×3, and 1×1 convolutions, where the 1×1 layers are responsible for reducing and then increasing (restoring) dimensions, leaving the 3×3 layer a bottleneck with smaller input/output dimensions15. Fig. 5 shows an example, where both designs have similar time complexity.

用，但形态反过来了。今天主流的是倒残差（inverted bottleneck） —— 先扩张再压缩，而不是先压缩再扩张。

Transformer 里其实无处不在。每个 block 的前馈层就是一个标准的倒瓶颈：d → 4d → d。ViT、BERT、GPT 全系列都是这个结构，只是没人叫它 bottleneck。SwiGLU 之后中间比例变成约 8/3 d，但要两个上投影矩阵，参数量对齐回 4d。

注意力部分也有瓶颈味道：每个头的维度是 d/h，QKV 投影把 d 压到低维子空间做交互再拼回来。

卷积这边的转向：

MobileNetV2（2018）明确翻转：深度可分离卷积本身已经很便宜，中间反而要扩张（比例 6），且最后一层 1×1 去掉 ReLU（linear bottleneck），理由是低维空间上的 ReLU 会不可逆地丢信息
EfficientNet沿用 MBConv，把扩张比作为搜索维度之一
ConvNeXt（2022）从 ResNet-50 出发对齐 Swin 的设计，其中一步就是把经典瓶颈换成倒瓶颈

反例也存在。RegNet 用设计空间搜索扫了瓶颈比 b，结论是 b = 1 最好 —— 干脆不要瓶颈。这说明 ResNet 那个 4 倍压缩比更像是当年 FLOPs 预算下的产物，不是普适最优。

真正留下来的是「在低维子空间做昂贵计算」这个思想，比具体形状活得久：LoRA 就是纯粹的低秩瓶颈适配器，参数量压到千分之几；各种 KV cache 压缩、MoE 的路由维度也是同一套逻辑。

一句话：用同样的计算量换更多的深度。

关键在 3×3 卷积的开销正比于 k²·C_in·C_out，对通道数是平方级的。Fig. 5 的两个块都画在 56×56 上：

基础块（进出 64 维） 3×3, 64→64 36,864 参数 115.6 M 乘加 3×3, 64→64 36,864 115.6 M 合计 73,728 231.2 M 瓶颈块（进出 256 维） 1×1, 256→64 16,384 51.4 M 3×3, 64→64 36,864 115.6 M 1×1, 64→256 16,384 51.4 M 合计 69,632 218.4 M

瓶颈块反而比基础块少 5.6%，而它进出的通道数是 4 倍、层数还多一层。论文说的 similar time complexity 不是约等于，是真的更小。

写成闭式更清楚。令 c = 64，把 H·W 提出来后每像素的乘加数：

基础块（进出 c）2 · 3²(c·c)18c²
瓶颈块（外 4c，内 c）2 · 1²(4c·c) + 3²(c·c)17c²
不用瓶颈，两层 3×3 撑 4c2 · 3²(4c·4c)288c²

288 ÷ 17 = 16.94 倍。原因是瓶颈块让 3×3 从头到尾只面对 64 个通道，两端的 1×1 按 256×64 计价。一般式：外层 e·c、内层 c、核 k×k 的瓶颈块是 (2e + k²)c²，同宽的两层 k×k 是 2k²e²c²。

整网的回报：ResNet-34 是 3.6 G FLOPs，ResNet-50 是 3.8 G —— 深了 16 层，成本只多 5.6%。

1

The parameter-free identity shortcuts are particularly important for the bottleneck architectures. If the identity shortcut in Fig. 5 (right) is replaced with projection, one can show that the time complexity and model size are doubled, as the shortcut is connected to the two high-dimensional ends16. So identity shortcuts lead to more efficient models for the bottleneck designs.

跟绝对宽度无关，只跟压缩比有关。

Fig. 5 右边那个块进出都是 256 维、形状本来就匹配，所以它的捷径在 A 和 B 里都是恒等，只有 C 才把它换成 1×1：

瓶颈块本体 69,632 加一条 1×1 投影捷径 +65,536 ───────── 135,168

135,168 ÷ 69,632 = 1.94 倍，这就是论文说的 doubled。

把整个块等比缩小，涨幅一模一样：

256 → 64 → 25669,632+65,53694.1%
64 → 16 → 644,352+4,09694.1%

因为所有项都是 c 的平方，算比值时 c 直接约掉：涨幅 = e² ÷ (2e + k²)，式子里没有 c。基础块同理，宽 512 还是宽 32 都恒定 5.6%。

e = 1 9.1% e = 4 94.1% e = 2 30.8% e = 8 256.0%

机制：瓶颈把「块」压小了约 17 倍，却压不了「捷径」 —— 捷径必须从全宽走到全宽，用不上压缩这一招。于是捷径从零头变成了跟整块一样大。

原文 the two high-dimensional ends 里的 high-dimensional 是相对块内部的低维中间说的，不是「256 这个数很大」。同一个块里有 256 和 64 两种宽度，捷径碰的是宽的两端，而最贵的 3×3 只碰窄的中间。

1

50-layer ResNet: We replace each 2-layer block in the 34-layer net with this 3-layer bottleneck block, resulting in a 50-layer ResNet (Table 1). We use option B for increasing dimensions17. This model has 3.8 billion FLOPs.

三件事：

一、最大的一跳是免费的。plain-34 → ResNet-34 A，top-1 降 3.51，参数一个没多（两行数字完全相同），FLOPs 也没变。

The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins (Table 3 and 5). We do not observe the degradation problem and thus enjoy significant accuracy gains from considerably increased depth. The benefits of depth are witnessed for all evaluation metrics (Table 3 and 5).

Comparisons with State-of-the-art Methods. In Table 5 we compare with the previous best single-model results. Our baseline 34-layer ResNets have achieved very competitive accuracy. Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%. This single-model result outperforms all previous ensemble results (Table 5). We combine six models of different depth to form an ensemble (only with two 152-layer ones at the time of submitting). This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set (Table 5). This entry won the 1st place in ILSVRC 2015.

脚注

3 We have experimented with more training iterations (3×) and still observed the degradation problem, suggesting that this problem cannot be feasibly addressed by simply using more iterations.

4 Deeper non-bottleneck ResNets (e.g., Fig. 5 left) also gain accuracy from increased depth (as shown on CIFAR-10), but are not as economical as the bottleneck ResNets. So the usage of bottleneck designs is mainly due to practical considerations. We further note that the degradation problem of plain nets is also witnessed for the bottleneck designs.

4.2CIFAR-10 and Analysis

We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset [20], which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes. We present experiments trained on the training set and evaluated on the test set. Our focus is on the behaviors of extremely deep networks, but not on pushing the state-of-the-art results, so we intentionally use simple architectures as follows.

The plain/residual architectures follow the form in Fig. 3 (middle/right). The network inputs are 32×32 images, with the per-pixel mean subtracted. The first layer is 3×3 convolutions. Then we use a stack of 6​n layers with 3×3 convolutions on the feature maps of sizes {32,16,8} respectively, with 2n layers for each feature map size. The numbers of filters are {16,32,64} respectively. The subsampling is performed by convolutions with a stride of 2. The network ends with a global average pooling, a 10-way fully-connected layer, and softmax. There are totally 6n+2 stacked weighted layers. The following table summarizes the architecture:

1

When shortcut connections are used, they are connected to the pairs of 3×3 layers (totally 3​n shortcuts). On this dataset we use identity shortcuts in all cases19 (i.e., option A), so our residual models have exactly the same depth, width, and number of parameters as the plain counterparts.

为了把「参数量」这个变量彻底钉死。这半句后面紧跟着理由：so our residual models have exactly the same depth, width, and number of parameters as the plain counterparts。

CIFAR 这一节要比的是 20 / 32 / 44 / 56 / 110 层这一整条深度曲线。如果捷径带参数，「越深越好」就可能被解释成「越深参数越多」。用 A 之后，plain-56 和 ResNet-56 的参数数字一模一样，唯一的差别就是那条线。

CIFAR 这套网络跟 ImageNet 那套是两套结构，别混：

输入32×32，不是 224×224
层数公式6n + 2：1 层 stem + 6n 层在块里 + 1 层全连接
三个 stage特征图 32 / 16 / 8，通道 16 / 32 / 64，各 2n 层
块类型全是基础块，没有瓶颈块

通道只到 64，所以这些网络非常小：110 层才 1.7 M 参数，比 ImageNet 上 18 层的还小一个量级。

顺带一提 1202 层那次：训练误差压到 0.1% 以下，没有出现优化困难，但测试误差（7.93%）反而不如 110 层（6.43%）。论文把这归因于过拟合 —— 19.4 M 参数对 CIFAR-10 这种小数据集太大了。注意这次是真的过拟合（训练误差相当而测试更差），跟第 1 节那个「退化」是两回事。

We use a weight decay of 0.0001 and momentum of 0.9, and adopt the weight initialization in [13] and BN [16] but with no dropout. These models are trained with a mini-batch size of 128 on two GPUs. We start with a learning rate of 0.1, divide it by 10 at 32k and 48k iterations, and terminate training at 64k iterations, which is determined on a 45k/5k train/val split. We follow the simple data augmentation in [24] for training: 4 pixels are padded on each side, and a 32×32 crop is randomly sampled from the padded image or its horizontal flip. For testing, we only evaluate the single view of the original 32×32 image.

We compare n={3,5,7,9}, leading to 20, 32, 44, and 56-layer networks. Fig. 6 (left) shows the behaviors of the plain nets. The deep plain nets suffer from increased depth, and exhibit higher training error when going deeper. This phenomenon is similar to that on ImageNet (Fig. 4, left) and on MNIST (see [42]), suggesting that such an optimization difficulty is a fundamental problem.

Fig. 6 (middle) shows the behaviors of ResNets. Also similar to the ImageNet cases (Fig. 4, right), our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.

1

We further explore n=18 that leads to a 110-layer ResNet. In this case, we find that the initial learning rate of 0.1 is slightly too large to start converging5. So we use 0.01 to warm up the training20 until the training error is below 80% (about 400 iterations), and then go back to 0.1 and continue training. The rest of the learning schedule is as done previously. This 110-layer network converges well (Fig. 6, middle). It has fewer parameters than other deep and thin networks such as FitNet [35] and Highway [42] (Table 6), yet is among the state-of-the-art results (6.43%, Table 6).

算是，但要分两半说。

「是」的那一半：这段确实是后来所有 warmup 文献引的源头。2017 年 Goyal 等人的《Accurate, Large Minibatch SGD》把这种做法命名为 constant warmup 并引 ResNet，然后才提出自己的 gradual warmup（线性爬坡）。

「不是」的那一半：这里的做法跟今天说的 warmup 有三处根本不同。

形状0.01 常数一段，然后跳到 0.1；今天是线性爬坡
触发靠条件（训练误差降到 80% 以下），不是固定步数
地位只用在 CIFAR-10 的那一个 110 层模型上，ImageNet 的五个模型一次都没用

规模也完全不是一回事：约 400 次迭代，占全程 64,000 次的 0.6%。「warm」这个词在整篇论文里只出现过一次，就在这句里 —— 它不是论文提出的方法，是个脚注级别的权宜之计。

最关键的一点：它其实可有可无。脚注 5 自己交代了 it starts converging (<90% error) after several epochs, but still reaches similar accuracy —— 不做 warmup 也能收敛，最终精度差不多。这跟今天 Transformer 里「去掉就训不起来」的量级完全不同。

三代对照：ResNet 是 ~400 步的常数段；Goyal 2017 是 5 个 epoch 线性从 η/k 爬到 η，为的是 batch 开到 8192 时开头会崩；Transformer 是 4000 步线性爬坡后按 step⁻⁰·⁵ 衰减。

一句提醒：不能断言这是史上第一次有人用小学习率起步 —— 「先小后大」更早就有人做过，只是没当成一个有名字的独立阶段。能确定的是「warmup」这个名字和后续引用链的源头就是这一段。

std 是一层一个数。取某个 3×3 层的输出（Batch Normalization 之后、ReLU 和加法之前），这是个 (N, C, H, W) 的张量，把里面所有数的标准差算出来。110 层的网络画 109 个点。

为什么用标准差而不是均值：BN 之后均值基本被 β 拽住了，不含信息。BN 把每个通道归一化成零均值单位方差，再做 γ·x̂ + β，所以输出的标准差约等于 |γ| —— 这一层学出来的缩放系数。std 小 = 这一层输出的东西幅度小 = ℱ 接近 0 = 这个块接近「什么都不做」。

sorted by magnitude 是同一批数换个排法。magnitude 是「大小、幅度」（词根是拉丁语 magnus「大」，同族的有 magnify、magnificent），不是维度。上图横轴是「第几层」，按真实顺序画；下图把这些数从大到小排序再画，横轴变成名次，第 k 个点是「第 k 大的 std」。

下面平滑是排序的必然结果，不是发现。任何一串数从大到小排完都是单调下降的 —— 拿一串随机数来排也一样平滑。

上面乱才是真实数据。相邻两层本来就没理由 std 接近。图里那种一高一低的交替，跟每个块有两个 3×3 层、两层角色不同是对得上的（论文没分析这点）。

一个能对上的细节：红线和黑线都在第 37 层附近有尖峰。CIFAR 的结构是「第 1 层是 stem，之后每 stage 各 2n 层」，所以 n = 9 的边界在 19/20 与 37/38，n = 18 的边界在 37/38 与 73/74 —— 两个网络恰好都在那里有一道 stage 边界（通道翻倍、空间减半）。

那下图有什么用：让深度不同的网络能放在一起比。排完序能直接读出论文那两句结论：普通网络整条曲线压在同深度 ResNet 之上；ResNet-110 又贴在 ResNet-56 下面。

一个小毛病：下图横轴用的是绝对名次，两条曲线长度不同，x = 40 处比的是「110 个里第 40 大」（前 36%）和「55 个里第 40 大」（前 73%），不是同一分位数。不过这个偏差对论文结论不利 —— 曲线递减，同一绝对名次上长曲线天然处在更靠前的分位、值本该更大，ResNet-110 仍然更低，说明真实差距比图上看着还大。

Analysis of Layer Responses. Fig. 7 shows the standard deviations (std) of the layer responses. The responses are the outputs of each 3×3 layer, after BN and before other nonlinearity (ReLU/addition). For ResNets, this analysis reveals the response strength of the residual functions. Fig. 7 shows that ResNets have generally smaller responses than their plain counterparts. These results support our basic motivation (Sec.3.1) that the residual functions might be generally closer to zero than the non-residual functions. We also notice that the deeper ResNet has smaller magnitudes of responses, as evidenced by the comparisons among ResNet-20, 56, and 110 in Fig. 7. When there are more layers, an individual layer of ResNets tends to modify the signal less.

Exploring Over 1000 layers. We explore an aggressively deep model of over 1000 layers. We set n=200 that leads to a 1202-layer network, which is trained as described above. Our method shows no optimization difficulty, and this 103-layer network is able to achieve training error <0.1% (Fig. 6, right). Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).

But there are still open problems on such aggressively deep models. The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error. We argue that this is because of overfitting. The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset. Strong regularization such as maxout [10] or dropout [14] is applied to obtain the best results ([10, 25, 24, 35]) on this dataset. In this paper, we use no maxout/dropout and just simply impose regularization via deep and thin architectures by design, without distracting from the focus on the difficulties of optimization. But combining with stronger regularization may improve results, which we will study in the future.

4.3Object Detection on PASCAL and MS COCO

1

Our method has good generalization performance on other recognition tasks. Table 8 and 8 show the object detection baseline results on PASCAL VOC 2007 and 2012 [5] and COCO [26]. We adopt Faster R-CNN [32] as the detection method. Here we are interested in the improvements of replacing VGG-16 [41] with ResNet-101. The detection implementation (see appendix) of using both models is the same, so the gains can only be attributed to better networks22. Most remarkably, on the challenging COCO dataset we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5, .95]), which is a 28% relative improvement. This gain is solely due to the learned representations.

ImageNet 和 COCO 有渊源。COCO（Common Objects in Context）2014 年发布，冲的就是 ImageNet 的短板：ImageNet 的图大多是一个物体占满画面的「肖像照」，而 COCO 刻意收日常场景 —— 平均每张图 7.7 个目标，大量小物体和遮挡。类别只有 80 个，但每类的实例多得多。

所以两者不是替代关系：ImageNet 考「认得出吗」，COCO 考「在乱糟糟的场景里全找出来了吗」。ResNet 这一年把四条全拿了，含金量在于它们考的其实是同一件事 —— 特征好不好，而不是检测框架调得好不好。

Appendix AObject Detection Baselines

In this section we introduce our detection method based on the baseline Faster R-CNN [32] system. The models are initialized by the ImageNet classification models, and then fine-tuned on the object detection data. We have experimented with ResNet-50/101 at the time of the ILSVRC & COCO 2015 detection competitions.

Unlike VGG-16 used in [32], our ResNet has no hidden fc layers. We adopt the idea of “Networks on Conv feature maps” (NoC) [33] to address this issue. We compute the full-image shared conv feature maps using those layers whose strides on the image are no greater than 16 pixels (i.e., conv1, conv2_ x, conv3_x, and conv4_x, totally 91 conv layers in ResNet-101; Table 1). We consider these layers as analogous to the 13 conv layers in VGG-16, and by doing so, both ResNet and VGG-16 have conv feature maps of the same total stride (16 pixels). These layers are shared by a region proposal network (RPN, generating 300 proposals) [32] and a Fast R-CNN detection network [7]. RoI pooling [7] is performed before conv5_1. On this RoI-pooled feature, all layers of conv5_x and up are adopted for each region, playing the roles of VGG-16’s fc layers. The final classification layer is replaced by two sibling layers (classification and box regression [7]).

For the usage of BN layers, after pre-training, we compute the BN statistics (means and variances) for each layer on the ImageNet training set. Then the BN layers are fixed during fine-tuning for object detection. As such, the BN layers become linear activations with constant offsets and scales, and BN statistics are not updated by fine-tuning. We fix the BN layers mainly for reducing memory consumption in Faster R-CNN training.

PASCAL VOC

Following [7, 32], for the PASCAL VOC 2007 test set, we use the 5k trainval images in VOC 2007 and 16k trainval images in VOC 2012 for training (“07+12”). For the PASCAL VOC 2012 test set, we use the 10k trainval+test images in VOC 2007 and 16k trainval images in VOC 2012 for training (“07++12”). The hyper-parameters for training Faster R-CNN are the same as in [32]. Table 8 shows the results. ResNet-101 improves the mAP by >3% over VGG-16. This gain is solely because of the improved features learned by ResNet.

MS COCO

The MS COCO dataset [26] involves 80 object categories. We evaluate the PASCAL VOC metric (mAP @ IoU = 0.5) and the standard COCO metric (mAP @ IoU = .5:.05:.95). We use the 80k images on the train set for training and the 40k images on the val set for evaluation. Our detection system for COCO is similar to that for PASCAL VOC. We train the COCO models with an 8-GPU implementation, and thus the RPN step has a mini-batch size of 8 images (i.e., 1 per GPU) and the Fast R-CNN step has a mini-batch size of 16 images. The RPN step and Fast R-CNN step are both trained for 240k iterations with a learning rate of 0.001 and then for 80k iterations with 0.0001.

Table 8 shows the results on the MS COCO validation set. ResNet-101 has a 6% increase of mAP@[.5, .95] over VGG-16, which is a 28% relative improvement, solely contributed by the features learned by the better network. Remarkably, the mAP@[.5, .95]’s absolute increase (6.0%) is nearly as big as mAP@.5’s (6.9%). This suggests that a deeper network can improve both recognition and localization.

Appendix BObject Detection Improvements

For completeness, we report the improvements made for the competitions. These improvements are based on deep features and thus should benefit from residual learning.

MS COCO

Box refinement. Our box refinement partially follows the iterative localization in [6]. In Faster R-CNN, the final output is a regressed box that is different from its proposal box. So for inference, we pool a new feature from the regressed box and obtain a new classification score and a new regressed box. We combine these 300 new predictions with the original 300 predictions. Non-maximum suppression (NMS) is applied on the union set of predicted boxes using an IoU threshold of 0.3 [8], followed by box voting [6]. Box refinement improves mAP by about 2 points (Table 9).

Global context. We combine global context in the Fast R-CNN step. Given the full-image conv feature map, we pool a feature by global Spatial Pyramid Pooling [12] (with a “single-level” pyramid) which can be implemented as “RoI” pooling using the entire image’s bounding box as the RoI. This pooled feature is fed into the post-RoI layers to obtain a global context feature. This global feature is concatenated with the original per-region feature, followed by the sibling classification and box regression layers. This new structure is trained end-to-end. Global context improves mAP@.5 by about 1 point (Table 9).

Multi-scale testing. In the above, all results are obtained by single-scale training/testing as in [32], where the image’s shorter side is s=600 pixels. Multi-scale training/testing has been developed in [12, 7] by selecting a scale from a feature pyramid, and in [33] by using maxout layers. In our current implementation, we have performed multi-scale testing following [33]; we have not performed multi-scale training because of limited time. In addition, we have performed multi-scale testing only for the Fast R-CNN step (but not yet for the RPN step). With a trained model, we compute conv feature maps on an image pyramid, where the image’s shorter sides are s∈{200,400,600,800,1000}. We select two adjacent scales from the pyramid following [33]. RoI pooling and subsequent layers are performed on the feature maps of these two scales [33], which are merged by maxout as in [33]. Multi-scale testing improves the mAP by over 2 points (Table 9).

Using validation data. Next we use the 80k+40k trainval set for training and the 20k test-dev set for evaluation. The test-dev set has no publicly available ground truth and the result is reported by the evaluation server. Under this setting, the results are an mAP@.5 of 55.7% and an mAP@[.5, .95] of 34.9% (Table 9). This is our single-model result.

Ensemble. In Faster R-CNN, the system is designed to learn region proposals and also object classifiers, so an ensemble can be used to boost both tasks. We use an ensemble for proposing regions, and the union set of proposals are processed by an ensemble of per-region classifiers. Table 9 shows our result based on an ensemble of 3 networks. The mAP is 59.0% and 37.4% on the test-dev set. This result won the 1st place in the detection task in COCO 2015.

PASCAL VOC

We revisit the PASCAL VOC dataset based on the above model. With the single model on the COCO dataset (55.7% mAP@.5 in Table 9), we fine-tune this model on the PASCAL VOC sets. The improvements of box refinement, context, and multi-scale testing are also adopted. By doing so we achieve 85.6% mAP on PASCAL VOC 2007 (Table 11) and 83.8% on PASCAL VOC 2012 (Table 11)6. The result on PASCAL VOC 2012 is 10 points higher than the previous state-of-the-art result [6].

ImageNet Detection

The ImageNet Detection (DET) task involves 200 object categories. The accuracy is evaluated by mAP@.5. Our object detection algorithm for ImageNet DET is the same as that for MS COCO in Table 9. The networks are pre-trained on the 1000-class ImageNet classification set, and are fine-tuned on the DET data. We split the validation set into two parts (val1/val2) following [8]. We fine-tune the detection models using the DET training set and the val1 set. The val2 set is used for validation. We do not use other ILSVRC 2015 data. Our single model with ResNet-101 has 58.8% mAP and our ensemble of 3 models has 62.1% mAP on the DET test set (Table 12). This result won the 1st place in the ImageNet detection task in ILSVRC 2015, surpassing the second place by 8.5 points (absolute).

Appendix CImageNet Localization

The ImageNet Localization (LOC) task [36] requires to classify and localize the objects. Following [40, 41], we assume that the image-level classifiers are first adopted for predicting the class labels of an image, and the localization algorithm only accounts for predicting bounding boxes based on the predicted classes. We adopt the “per-class regression” (PCR) strategy [40, 41], learning a bounding box regressor for each class. We pre-train the networks for ImageNet classification and then fine-tune them for localization. We train networks on the provided 1000-class ImageNet training set.

Our localization algorithm is based on the RPN framework of [32] with a few modifications. Unlike the way in [32] that is category-agnostic, our RPN for localization is designed in a per-class form. This RPN ends with two sibling 1×1 convolutional layers for binary classification (cls) and box regression (reg), as in [32]. The cls and reg layers are both in a per-class from, in contrast to [32]. Specifically, the cls layer has a 1000-d output, and each dimension is binary logistic regression for predicting being or not being an object class; the reg layer has a 1000×4-d output consisting of box regressors for 1000 classes. As in [32], our bounding box regression is with reference to multiple translation-invariant “anchor” boxes at each position.

As in our ImageNet classification training (Sec. 3.4), we randomly sample 224×224 crops for data augmentation. We use a mini-batch size of 256 images for fine-tuning. To avoid negative samples being dominate, 8 anchors are randomly sampled for each image, where the sampled positive and negative anchors have a ratio of 1:1 [32]. For testing, the network is applied on the image fully-convolutionally.

Table 13 compares the localization results. Following [41], we first perform “oracle” testing using the ground truth class as the classification prediction. VGG’s paper [41] reports a center-crop error of 33.1% (Table 13) using ground truth classes. Under the same setting, our RPN method using ResNet-101 net significantly reduces the center-crop error to 13.3%. This comparison demonstrates the excellent performance of our framework. With dense (fully convolutional) and multi-scale testing, our ResNet-101 has an error of 11.7% using ground truth classes. Using ResNet-101 for predicting classes (4.6% top-5 classification error, Table 5), the top-5 localization error is 14.4%.

The above results are only based on the proposal network (RPN) in Faster R-CNN [32]. One may use the detection network (Fast R-CNN [7]) in Faster R-CNN to improve the results. But we notice that on this dataset, one image usually contains a single dominate object, and the proposal regions highly overlap with each other and thus have very similar RoI-pooled features. As a result, the image-centric training of Fast R-CNN [7] generates samples of small variations, which may not be desired for stochastic training. Motivated by this, in our current experiment we use the original R-CNN [8] that is RoI-centric, in place of Fast R-CNN.

Our R-CNN implementation is as follows. We apply the per-class RPN trained as above on the training images to predict bounding boxes for the ground truth class. These predicted boxes play a role of class-dependent proposals. For each training image, the highest scored 200 proposals are extracted as training samples to train an R-CNN classifier. The image region is cropped from a proposal, warped to 224×224 pixels, and fed into the classification network as in R-CNN [8]. The outputs of this network consist of two sibling fc layers for cls and reg, also in a per-class form. This R-CNN network is fine-tuned on the training set using a mini-batch size of 256 in the RoI-centric fashion. For testing, the RPN generates the highest scored 200 proposals for each predicted class, and the R-CNN network is used to update these proposals’ scores and box positions.

This method reduces the top-5 localization error to 10.6% (Table 13). This is our single-model result on the validation set. Using an ensemble of networks for both classification and localization, we achieve a top-5 localization error of 9.0% on the test set. This number significantly outperforms the ILSVRC 14 results (Table 14), showing a 64% relative reduction of error. This result won the 1st place in the ImageNet localization task in ILSVRC 2015.

先把边界划清

旁路连接早就有，带门控的深网络旁路也比本文早七个月。这篇的新东西是一条不带参数、永远打开的旁路，以及在 ImageNet 上把一百多层做出精度收益的实证。

时间工作旁路长什么样
1990 年代训练多层感知机的早期做法（本文文献 [34][49]）在网络输入和输出之间加一层线性连接
2015-05-03Highway Networks，Srivastava、Greff、Schmidhuber（完整版是 NeurIPS 2015 的 Training Very Deep Networks）y = H(x)·T(x) + x·C(x)，论文取 C = 1 − T；T 由 x 算出，带权重
2015-12-10本文，arXiv 首版；CVPR 2016y = ℱ(x) + x，旁路上什么都没有

两个式子差在门上。Highway 把 carry gate 设成 C = 1 − T，T 和 C 就不能同时为 1，变换路全开时旁路一定是关着的。它建议把 T 的偏置初始化成负数（原文举例 −1、−3），让网络 initially biased towards carry behavior，这时一层的输出接近 x 本身。ℱ(x) + x 这种「输入加修正量」的形式需要 T 和 C 同时为 1，耦合之后做不到。本文的旁路没有门，x 永远原样加进来。

论文第 2 节对 Highway 的判断是 highway networks have not demonstrated accuracy gains with extremely increased depth，括号里举的是超过 100 层。Table 6 放了一组 CIFAR-10 对照：Highway 19 层 7.54%、32 层 8.80%，ResNet 110 层 6.43%。Highway 这两个数引自 Highway 论文本身，不是本文在同一设置下复现的。

优先权的争议

本文第 2 节把 Highway 称作 Concurrent with our work，并在 gating functions 处引了 LSTM（文献 [15]）。Highway 的作者之一 Jürgen Schmidhuber 不接受这个定性，理由是 Highway 的 arXiv 首版比本文早七个月。他 2025 年 9 月在 arXiv 发了 Who invented deep residual learning?，时间线从 1991 年 Hochreiter 权重固定为 1.0 的循环残差连接排起，经过 1997 年的 LSTM，到 2015 年 5 月的 Highway。他个人主页上的说法是：把 Highway 的两个门都设成 1 并保持打开，得到的就是 ResNet，ResNet 是 Highway 的 open-gated variant。

Schmidhuber 用的是 Highway 论文里的一般形式，两个门各自独立；Highway 论文的实验用的是耦合形式 C = 1 − T，这个形式下两个门没法同时为 1。Highway 把灵感来源写得很清楚（They are inspired by Long Short-Term Memory recurrent networks），本文则自称 152 层是 the deepest network ever presented on ImageNet。分歧落在「去掉门」算不算一项独立的发明，属于评价，这里不下结论。

成绩：论文自报和外部认可分开看

各项做法今天的境遇

这篇自己的结构设计里，原样留到今天的主要是恒等旁路。Transformer 的每个子层外面都包着残差连接，Vaswani 等人 2017 年的原文引的就是本文。其余细节在之后几年里被逐项改写，改动来自三个方向：

方向工作与改动
作者自己ResNet v2（2016，同一批作者）：把 Batch Normalization 和 ReLU 挪进残差分支，加法之后不再有非线性，信号能从任意一个块直接传到另一个块。CIFAR-10 上 1001 层做到 4.62%
工程细节Bag of Tricks（2018）：ResNet-B、C、D 三处结构微调，在他们的复现基线上把 ResNet-50 的 top-1 从 76.21% 提到 77.16%；全部技巧叠加后，摘要给出的是 75.3% 到 79.29%
结构思路MobileNetV2（2018）让残差块两端窄、中间宽；RegNet（2020）的搜索结果里，最好的模型瓶颈比为 1；ConvNeXt（2022）从一个标准 ResNet 出发，逐步朝视觉 Transformer 的设计改

缺陷

论文自己留下的空白

空白论文里怎么写的后来
退化的原因只有一句猜想 the deep plain nets may have exponentially low convergence rates，原因留给 will be studied in the futureVeit 等（2016）：110 层 ResNet 的梯度主要来自 10 到 34 层深的路径。Balduzzi 等（2017）：普通网络里梯度的相关性随深度指数衰减，带跳连的只按次线性衰减。Li 等（2018）用可视化比较不同结构的损失曲面。三篇各给了一种解释，角度不同
1202 层不如 110 层CIFAR-10 上 7.93% 对 6.43%，论文归因于过拟合，但没有加正则做对照，原文说明 we use no maxout/dropoutStochastic Depth（2016）训练时随机跳过整层，把网络加到 1200 层以上，CIFAR-10 做到 4.91%；ResNet v2 的 1001 层是 4.62%
ImageNet 对照只跑一次Table 2、3 没有方差，选项 A、B、C 之间只差 0.51 和 0.33 个百分点CIFAR 部分做了重复：ResNet-110 跑五次，报的 6.43% 是最好的一次，均值 6.61 ± 0.16

结构上后来被证明能做得更好

设计问题后来的改法
加法之后的 ReLU恒等路径上多了一层非线性ResNet v2 的 pre-activation
下采样块主路第一个 1×1 和捷径上的 1×1 都是 stride 2，各丢掉四分之三的输入ResNet-B 把主路的 stride 挪到 3×3；ResNet-D 在捷径上先做平均池化
固定的 4 倍瓶颈论文说改成瓶颈是出于 concerns on the training time that we can affordRegNet 发现瓶颈比为 1 的模型最好
依赖 Batch Normalizationbatch 变小时误差上升。本文做检测微调时直接冻结了 Batch Normalization 层，附录给的理由是省显存Group Normalization：ResNet-50 在 batch 为 2 时，误差比同设置的 Batch Normalization 低 10.6 个百分点

架构的功劳和训练配方混在一起

后来几篇工作专门把这两件事拆开。Bag of Tricks 靠结构微调加训练技巧，把 ResNet-50 的 top-1 从 75.3% 提到 79.29%。Wightman 等人（2021）不改结构、只换训练配方，原版 ResNet-50 在 224 分辨率下做到 80.4%，没有额外数据，也没有蒸馏。Bello 等人（2021）的结论写得最直接：training and scaling strategies may matter more than architectural changes。

这对读本文的表有影响。Table 3 各行共用一套训练配方，行与行的差距可以归到结构上；拿这些数字和后来的模型比绝对精度，比进去的就还有配方。

何恺明（Kaiming He）

2009Dark Channel Prior 单图去雾一作（与孙剑、汤晓鸥）统计户外无雾图像得到的先验：大多数局部块里，总有像素在某个颜色通道上亮度极低。配合成像模型直接估计雾的厚度，从单张图恢复无雾图像，深度图是副产品。CVPR 2009 Best Paper Award
2014SPPNet 空间金字塔池化一作在卷积特征图上做空间金字塔池化，任意尺寸的输入都得到定长表示。做检测时整张图只算一次卷积特征，再对各个区域池化，省掉重复计算。TPAMI 2015
2015PReLU 与 He 初始化一作把整流单元推广成负半轴斜率可学的 PReLU，并推导出专门考虑整流非线性的初始化，很深的网络能从头训练。ImageNet top-5 做到 4.94%，论文称是首次超过报告的人类水平 5.1%。ICCV 2015

2025 NeurIPS Test of Time Award
2015ResNet（本文）一作让堆叠的几层去学相对输入的残差，旁路把输入原样加回。152 层仍然好训，ILSVRC 2015 分类第一。CVPR 2016 Best Paper Award
2026 Longuet-Higgins Prize
2016Identity Mappings（ResNet v2）一作分析残差块里的信号传播：旁路和加法后的激活都取恒等时，前向和反向信号能在任意两个块之间直接传递。据此改用 pre-activation 残差单元，CIFAR-10 上 1001 层做到 4.62%。ECCV 2016
2016Feature Pyramid Networks第四作者利用卷积网络自带的多尺度层级，自顶向下加横向连接，以很小的额外开销构建各尺度都带高层语义的特征金字塔。接在 Faster R-CNN 上刷新了 COCO 单模型成绩。
2017Mask R-CNN一作在 Faster R-CNN 上加一个与框识别并行的分支，为每个物体预测分割掩码，额外开销很小，每秒 5 帧。同一框架还能做人体关键点检测。ICCV 2017 Marr Prize
2017Focal Loss（RetinaNet）第四作者（一作 Tsung-Yi Lin）找出单阶段检测器精度落后于两阶段的主因：训练时前景和背景极度不平衡。Focal Loss 调低易分样本的损失权重，配合单阶段检测器 RetinaNet 追上两阶段的精度。ICCV 2017 Best Student Paper Award
2018Group Normalization二作（与 Yuxin Wu）把通道分组，在组内算均值和方差，计算与 batch 大小无关。ResNet-50 在 batch 为 2 时，误差比 Batch Normalization 低 10.6 个百分点。ECCV 2018 Best Paper Honorable Mention
2018Rethinking ImageNet Pre-training一作在 COCO 上从随机初始化训练检测和分割，只要训练时间够长，结果不差于 ImageNet 预训练。预训练主要加快早期收敛，未必提高最终精度。
2019MoCo 动量对比一作把对比学习看成查字典，用队列和滑动平均更新的编码器维护一个又大又一致的字典。无监督学到的表征在 7 个检测和分割任务上超过有监督预训练。CVPR 2020
2020SimSiam二作（与 Xinlei Chen）简单的孪生网络不用负样本对、不用大 batch、也不用动量编码器，就能学到有意义的表征；防止坍缩的关键是 stop-gradient。CVPR 2021 Best Paper Honorable Mention
2021MAE 掩码自编码器一作随机遮掉输入图像 75% 的块，编码器只处理可见块，轻量的解码器负责重建像素。只用 ImageNet-1K 数据，ViT-Huge 达到 87.8%。
2024MAR：不用向量量化的自回归图像生成末位用扩散过程建模每个 token 的连续分布，把交叉熵换成 Diffusion Loss，自回归图像生成不再需要离散的 tokenizer。NeurIPS 2024 Spotlight
2025MeanFlow 一步生成末位引入「平均速度」刻画流场（Flow Matching 建模的是瞬时速度），一步采样就能生成图像。ImageNet 256×256 从头训练，一次函数求值的 FID 为 3.43。
2025JiT：Back to Basics: Let Denoising Generative Models Denoise二作（与 Tianhong Li）主张去噪模型直接预测干净图像，理由是自然图像落在低维流形上，带噪的量不在。在原始像素上用大 patch 的朴素 Transformer，不用 tokenizer、不用预训练、不加额外损失。

方向上的变化从这张表里看得出来。最早的代表作是 2009 年的单图去雾，属于传统图像处理；2014 到 2017 年集中在识别和检测；2018 年前后转向训练方法本身，比如 Group Normalization，以及不用 ImageNet 预训练能不能训好检测器；2019 到 2021 年是自监督表征学习；2024 年以后的几篇都在生成模型上。署名位置也在变，2024 年以后这三篇他都排在末位。

工具

ResNet 论文逐段精读 ↗

从头到尾把这篇读一遍，重点在「为什么残差好训」那段的直观解释和 Fig. 7 的读法。跟本页对照着看：他讲到哪一节，就在左边找对应的批注。

跟李沐学AI · 53 分钟 动手学深度学习 · 残差网络 ↗

deep-residual-networks · 官方代码与模型 ↗

作者本人放出来的 50 / 101 / 152 层 prototxt 和训练好的权重。想自己核对本页那些参数量和 stage 宽度，直接数这几个 prototxt 最快 —— 每个 stage 的第一块带 downsample 分支，其余没有，就是论文说的选项 B。

Kaiming He · Caffe CVPR 2016 官方版 ↗ILSVRC 2015 成绩 ↗

torchvision/models/resnet.py ↗

今天大家实际在用的那份实现，两百来行读得完。BasicBlock 和 Bottleneck 两个类对应论文 Fig. 5 的左右两半；那个 downsample 模块就是投影捷径，只在每个 stage 的第一块里非空 —— 选项 B 在代码里长这样。注意它把 stride 放在 3×3 上（所谓 v1.5），和论文原版放在第一个 1×1 上略有出入。

PyTorch Bag of Tricks：后续的 ResNet-B/C/D 改法 ↗

Identity Mappings in Deep Residual Networks ↗

同一批作者三个月后的续作，把本文「恒等那条路不能被打断」这个直觉推到底：ReLU 和 BN 全部挪进残差分支（pre-activation），让捷径成为一条从头通到尾、完全干净的加法路径。附带一组消融，逐个试了在捷径上加缩放、门控、dropout 会坏成什么样 —— 本文第 2 节对 Highway 的判断在这里被系统验证了一遍。ResNet-1001 在 CIFAR-10 上做到 4.62%。

He et al. · ECCV 2016

Residual Networks Behave Like Ensembles of Relatively Shallow Networks ↗

本文只说了退化被解决，没说清为什么。这篇给了一个流行的解释：n 个残差块展开后是 2ⁿ 条长度不等的路径的集合，训练时真正贡献梯度的是其中较短的那些。证据是删掉若干个块，网络几乎不掉点 —— 换成 VGG 删一层就崩。

Veit, Wilber, Belongie · NeurIPS 2016 另一种解释：破碎梯度 ↗

Visualizing the Loss Landscape of Neural Nets ↗

那组著名的三维曲面图就出自这里：同样深度，没有捷径的网络损失面是一片支离破碎的尖峰，加上捷径之后塌成一个平滑的碗。它给「退化是优化问题」提供了一个看得见的版本。要提醒的是这是降到二维的可视化，方向的选法会影响观感，当推测看，别当证明。

Li et al. · NeurIPS 2018 代码 ↗

Accurate, Large Minibatch SGD: Training ImageNet in 1 Hour ↗

本页那条 warmup 批注的下游。这篇把 4.2 节里那个「先用 0.01 跑 400 步」的土办法命名为 constant warmup 并引本文，然后提出线性爬坡的 gradual warmup，配合学习率随 batch 线性放大，把 batch 开到 8192 还能不掉点。今天所有框架里的 warmup 基本都是这条线下来的。

Goyal et al. · 2017

Netron ↗

浏览器里打开模型文件就能看计算图，不用装环境。拖一个 ResNet-50 的 onnx 进去，那 16 个块、4 条带 1×1 的投影捷径、12 条空捷径，一眼能数清楚 —— 比读 prototxt 直观。

Lutz Roeder GitHub ↗

COCO 数据集 ↗

4.3 节那条赛道的主场。官网的 Explore 可以逐张翻图，直观看出它和 ImageNet 的差别：ImageNet 大多是一个物体占满画面的「肖像照」，COCO 收的是日常场景，平均每张 7.7 个目标，小物体和遮挡成堆。Evaluate 页写着 mAP@[.5:.05:.95] 的完整定义。
